new_entities.name: CddReviewCase
new_entities.description: A CDD periodic or event-triggered review record for a corporate client. Tracks the full lifecycle from trigger to archival. Owned by SVC-015 (Compliance Core Service). The primary audit trail for MLR 2017 periodic review obligations.

fields.name: review_id
fields.description: Primary key

fields.name: client_id
fields.description: FK → corporate client entity (ENT-002 or equivalent corporate entity)

fields.name: review_type
fields.description: Whether review was scheduled or event-triggered

fields.name: trigger_reason
fields.description: Reason for review (scheduled cycle / UBO change / adverse media / sanctions update / transaction anomaly)

fields.name: risk_tier
fields.description: Client risk tier at time of trigger — determines review frequency and EDD requirements

fields.name: due_date
fields.description: Date by which review must be completed

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current lifecycle status

fields.name: assigned_to
fields.description: FK → KYC analyst assigned to this review

fields.name: documents_received
fields.description: List of documents received: [{document_type, received_at, verified, verified_by, verified_at}]

fields.name: ubo_structure
fields.description: Beneficial ownership structure: [{ubo_name, dob, nationality, ownership_percentage, verification_status}]

fields.name: screening_results
fields.description: Aggregated screening results: {sanctions_hit, pep_match, adverse_media_hit, screening_timestamp, screener_ref}

fields.name: risk_rating
fields.description: Updated risk rating following assessment — may differ from risk_tier at trigger

fields.name: risk_rating_changed
fields.description: True if risk_rating differs from prior KycAssessment.risk_rating

fields.name: edd_required
fields.description: True if Enhanced Due Diligence required

fields.name: review_decision
fields.description: Final decision by PER-052

fields.name: decision_rationale
fields.description: Mandatory rationale for the review decision — audit trail

fields.name: senior_manager_approval_id
fields.description: FK → approval record if exit decision required PER-059 approval

fields.name: next_review_date
fields.description: Scheduled date for next CDD review, set at decision

fields.name: triggered_at
fields.description: Timestamp when review was triggered

fields.name: assigned_at
fields.description: Timestamp when assigned to analyst

fields.name: decision_made_at
fields.description: Timestamp when review decision was recorded

fields.name: archived_at
fields.description: Timestamp when case was archived

design_decisions.decision: CddReviewCase is separate from KycAssessment — each review creates a new case while KycAssessment holds the current state.
design_decisions.rationale: KycAssessment is the current view; CddReviewCase is the historical audit trail. Separating them allows multiple reviews to be recorded while maintaining a clean current-state entity. Required by MLR 2017 record-keeping obligations.

new_entities.name: KycAssessment
new_entities.description: The current KYC/CDD assessment state for a client. Owned by SVC-014 (KYC/AML Service). Updated by each CDD review cycle. The single source of truth for current client risk rating and next review date.

fields.name: assessment_id
fields.description: Primary key

fields.name: client_id
fields.description: FK → client entity

fields.name: risk_rating
fields.description: Current client risk rating

fields.name: cdd_status
fields.description: CDD currency status

fields.name: last_reviewed_at
fields.description: Timestamp of last completed CDD review

fields.name: next_review_date
fields.description: Next scheduled CDD review date — determined by risk_rating

fields.name: pep_flag
fields.description: True if any UBO is a Politically Exposed Person

fields.name: sanctions_flag
fields.description: True if active sanctions concern on client or UBO

fields.name: enhanced_monitoring
fields.description: True if client is subject to enhanced transaction monitoring

fields.name: review_decision
fields.description: Decision from most recent review

fields.name: kyc_analyst_id
fields.description: Analyst responsible for last review

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Timestamp of last update

relationships.description: One KycAssessment has many CddReviewCases in history
